_note: The Gloaming, level 17: fey bargains at endless dusk. See docs/zones.md.

gloaming.name: the Gloaming
gloaming.description: A realm stuck at dusk, ruled by the fey, where every bargain has a catch.

gl_landing.name: The Moon Arch
gl_landing.description: A white arch. Through it, moonlight and lanterns.

gl_market.name: The Thorn Market
gl_market.description: A market under rose-thorn awnings. Everything is for sale, and nothing for money.

gl_stalls.name: The Strange Stalls
gl_stalls.description: Three stalls. A candle-maker, a nettle-seller, and a moth in a coat.

gl_maze1.name: The Briar Maze
gl_maze1.description: Walls of briar higher than your head, and paths that weren't there a moment ago.

gl_maze2.name: Deeper in the Briars
gl_maze2.description: The thorns lean in. One catches your sleeve and holds.

trap.name: the briars
trap.hit: The briars close round you and tear.
trap.avoid: You slip between the thorns as they close.

sign.name: thorns
sign.text: The briars ahead move when you're not looking. Go carefully.

gl_maze3.name: The Maze's Heart
gl_maze3.description: A clearing with a sundial that only shows dusk.

gl_hall.name: The Erlking's Hall
gl_hall.description: A hall of living antler and bark, hung with trophies. Some of them are people.

gl_court.name: The Hunting Court
gl_court.description: Where the Erlking holds his hunt. Horns sound from nowhere.

herald.name: the Thorn Herald
herald.label: Herald
herald.description: a fey with antlers and a smile with too many teeth
herald.details: A fey with antlers and a smile with too many teeth.

topics.work: Ask me about riddles, or the hunt.

riddles.text: Three riddles, and the Queen's favour is yours. What burns but is not fire? What follows but never walks? What answers but never speaks? Ask the stallholders: Tallow, Nettle and Moth. Ask the right one about the right thing.

hunt.text: The Erlking hunts mortals for sport. Hunt him instead. His horn can't be stopped; his spear can be dodged.

topics.candle: A candle burns but is not fire? No, child: a candle is fire. Try Moth.
topics.shadow: What follows but never walks? Your shadow. Correct.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.label: Fey
nettle.description: a thin fey selling stinging herbs
nettle.details: A thin fey selling stinging herbs.

topics.echo: What answers but never speaks? An echo. Correct.

moth.name: Moth
moth.label: Fey
moth.description: a moth in a velvet coat
moth.details: A moth in a velvet coat.

topics.candle: What burns but is not fire? Love, child. A moth would know. Correct.

thorn_knight_1.name: Thorn Knight
thorn_knight_1.label: Fey Knight
thorn_knight_1.description: a knight in armour of thorns, watching
thorn_knight_1.details: A knight in armour of thorns, watching.

thorn_knight_2.name: Thorn Knight
thorn_knight_2.label: Fey Knight
thorn_knight_2.description: a knight in armour of thorns, watching
thorn_knight_2.details: A knight in armour of thorns, watching.

thorn_knight_3.name: Thorn Knight
thorn_knight_3.label: Fey Knight
thorn_knight_3.description: a knight in armour of thorns, watching
thorn_knight_3.details: A knight in armour of thorns, watching.

erlking.name: the Erlking
erlking.label: Fey Lord
erlking.description: a lord of the hunt, antlered, with a spear and a horn
erlking.details: A lord of the hunt, antlered, with a spear and a horn.

attacks.name: hunting horn
attacks.hit: {actor} sounds his horn, and the hunt rides through {target}!

wild_hunt_spear.name: Wild Hunt Spear
wild_hunt_spear.whiff: your Wild Hunt Spear finds nothing.
wild_hunt_spear.description: The Erlking's spear. It wants to hunt, in any weather.

thornweave_mantle.name: Thornweave Mantle
thornweave_mantle.description: A mantle of rose-thorn, soft as silk to the wearer. +2 Presence, +2 Poise.

fey_court.name: The Fey Court
fey_court.description: The fey of the Gloaming. They keep their bargains to the letter, and expect you to.

rules.note: A bold thing, to kill a fey.

one.goal: What burns but is not fire? Ask the right stallholder about the candle.

two.goal: What follows but never walks? Ask the right one about the shadow.

three.goal: What answers but never speaks? Ask the right one about the echo.

back.goal: Tell the Herald: ASK HERALD ABOUT RIDDLES.

kill.goal: Hunt the Erlking, in his Hunting Court past the Briar Maze.

back.goal: Tell the Herald: ASK HERALD ABOUT HUNT.
